sections.A: Plantar fascia pair ke neeche edi se ungliyon tak mazboot patti hai. Jab is par load bardasht se zyada ho to edi ke neeche dard hota hai.
sections.B: Subah ke pehle qadmon ya baithne ke baad edi ke neeche tez chubhta dard, jo thora chalne se kam aur zyada khade rehne se phir barhta hai.
sections.C: Kya dard aaraam ke baad pehle qadmon par sab se zyada hai, dard kahan hai, aur kya kaam ya joote badle.
sections.D: Pair ki shakal, arch, sujan, joote, chaal aur edi ke andar ki taraf dabana.
sections.E: Yeh zyada tar clinical diagnosis hai: history aur dard ki jagah. Windlass test madadgar hai. Heel spur dard ki wajah sabit nahi karta.
sections.F: Heel fat pad, calcaneal stress fracture aur nerve ka dabna isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Achanak pop ke saath dard aur sujan (fascia phatna), ya squeeze test positive (stress fracture): refer.
sections.H: Red flags na hon, subah ke pehle qadmon ka dard aur edi ke andar dabane par dard: plantar fasciopathy.
sections.I: Pindli aur fascia par soft tissue kaam, aur takhne ki mobilisation.
sections.J: Education, fascia aur pindli ka loading (jaise heel raises), stretching aur zaroorat ho to taping ya insoles.
sections.K: Barf (thandi bottle par pair ghumana) aur TENS optional; lambe dard mein shockwave.
sections.L: Diagnosis confirm karein, samjhayein ke yeh mahinon mein theek hota hai, load control aur exercise shuru.
sections.M: Pehle qadmon ka dard, 10 minute chalne ka dard, windlass aur taaqat dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 45 saal ki nurse ko 3 mahine se subah edi ke neeche dard hai. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: education, load control, taaqat aur stretching.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
